transcript.text: Unfortunately, tonight is one of those nights, as I was informed earlier this afternoon, that
Stephanie Vaquer is not medically clear to compete. Trust me, I'm more disappointed than you are. But
the other half of the scheduled number one contenders match for the Women's World
Championship is still here tonight, or tonight in Fresno, Becky Lynch will go one on one
with Liv Morgan for the Women's World Championship.
